senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָלַם I) [strength, endurance,] nature, existence, world; (b. h.) life-time, eternity.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:20">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>עד עולם</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 1:22">I Sam. I, 22</cite>) <he>והלא אין עוֹלָמוֹ של לוי וכ׳</he> but the life-time (active service) of the Levite is only up to fifty years.

Kidd. 15ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XXI, 6 לְעֹלָם) הוה אמינא לע׳ ממש I might have thought, that it meant really for ever (for life); קמשמע לן לע׳ לעולמו של יובל it is intimated (by ושבתם וכ׳, Lev. XXV, 10) that l’‘olam means up to the period of the jubilee.

<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:15">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>עוֹלָמְךָ תראה בחייך וכ׳</he> mayest thou see (enjoy) thy existence during thy life-time, and thy future (reward be reserved) for the life of the world to come.
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b:105">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>קיבל עולמו</he> has received his reward in this world.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ber. IX, 5</cite> <he>כל חותמי … מן הע׳</he> (Bab. ed. 54ᵃ <he>עד הע׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) in all conclusions of benedictions in the Temple they used to say, (Blessed is the Lord …) from everlasting; <he>משקלקלו … אין ע׳ אלא אחד וכ׳ …</he> when the heretics (or Sadducees) degenerated and said, there is only one world, they ordained the formula, From everlasting to everlasting.

<cite ref="Pesachim 56a">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:19">Tosef. ib. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:19">III</cite>), 19 they did not say <he>ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לע׳ וָעֶד</he> blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom for ever and ever.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30:8">Gen. R. s. 30</cite>, a. fr. <he>ראה ע׳ חדש</he> has seen a new world (a great change).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳ שאין בו מות</he>, v. <cite ref="A03399"><he>אֲתָאנַסְיָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—

Y. Ned. XI, 42ᶜ bot. פירות הע׳ the fruits of the world, i.e. coming from some other place, opp. צבורים בסידקי.—ע׳ הזה (abbrev. עה״ז) this world, mundane existence; ע׳ הבא (abbrev. עה״ב) the world to come, the hereafter, also the Messianic days; the days of resurrection.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50a:17">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>לא כעה״ז עה״ב</he> not as in this world (the present), will it be in the Messianic days.
<cite ref="Berakhot 51a:18">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>זוכה ונוחל שני עולמים העה״ז והעה״ב</he> will be permitted to inherit two worlds, this world and the hereafter.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:16">Ab. IV, 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01659"><he>פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר</he></cite>.
Snh. X, 1, a. fr. חלק לעה״ב a share in the world to come (resurrection); a. v. fr.—אומות הע׳ (abbrev. אוה״ע, א״ה), v. אוּמָּה.—בית ע׳ (euphem.) cemetery.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:5">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. (interch. with <cite ref="P00823"><he>עֲלַם</he></cite> q. v.).—Pl. <he>עוֹלָמִים</he>, <cite ref="P00267"><he>עוֹלָמִין</he></cite>, <he>עוֹלָמוֹת</he>. Ber. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100a:16">Snh. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>שלש מאות ועשרה ע׳</he> three hundred and ten worlds (existences of beatitude).
Gen. R. s. 3, a. e. היה בורא ע׳ ומחריבן he created worlds and destroyed them again; a. fr.—בית ע׳ the permanent house, the Jerusalem Temple, opp. משכן the Tabernacle.
<cite ref="Sukkah 5b:8">Succ. 5ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>לְעוֹלָם</he>
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:2">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חיים לע׳</he> a life for ever (not ceasing).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:5">Keth. IV, 5</cite> <he>לע׳ היא ברשות וכ׳</he> she (the betrothed) continues to be under the father’s jurisdiction (sharing his legal status), until she is wedded.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:11">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>לע׳ … בכבוד אשתו</he> under all conditions a man must guard the honor of his wife.
<cite ref="Yevamot 46a">Yeb. 46ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>לע׳ אין גר עד וכ׳</he> a person is not considered a proselyte, until he has been circumcised and immersed; a. v. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (dialectic term) at all events, in spite of your argument, still.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 101a:3">Ḥull. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>לע׳ קסבר וכ׳</he> Rab may still be of the opinion that &c.; <cite ref="Berakhot 3a">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite>.
Ib. 3ᵇ לע׳ בחד וכ׳ I may still say, it refers to one person and to recent debris; a. fr.—מֵע׳ לא never.

<cite ref="Yoma 49a:10">Yoma 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מע׳ לא שאלני וכ׳</he> never (in my life) did a person consult me about &c.; (<cite ref="Chullin 7b">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M01202"><he>מימי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:9">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מע׳ לא טבע גברא וכ׳</he> never yet has a person been drowned in the Dead Sea; a. fr.
senses.label: b
